instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add 'Oswald' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts via import in index.css.
INSTALL LENIS: 'npm install @studio-freight/react-lenis' and wrap the app in it for smooth scrolling.
DARK MODE ONLY: Do not implement a light mode toggle. The brand is strictly dark.
NO ROUNDED CORNERS: Force 'rounded-none' on almost everything to maintain the sharp, aggressive sports aesthetic.
USE NOISE: Add the noise texture overlay (opacity 0.05) to the body background to prevent color banding and add grit.

HERO SECTION: Use the 'mood_sprint' image as a subtle background with heavy black overlay (90%), then place the 'hero_product' (Box) floating in the center-right with a cyan radial gradient behind it.
MARQUEE: Create a slow scrolling text band with 'LATEX FREE • HYPO ALLERGENIC • MEDICAL GRADE' using a transparent background and white borders.
COUNTDOWN: Implement a countdown to March 1, 2026, in the footer or hero.
FORMS: Use the 'inputs.default' style for the email signup. It should look like a terminal input or a technical spec line.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container.
Ensure all images have alt text.
